stories.title: Kenya confirms first Ebola case as virus ‘surges’ in DR Congo province
bullet_points: Health minister says 28 contacts identified after death of citizen who arrived from DRC on Saturday  Kenya has reported its first-ever Ebola death, the health minister announced on Tuesday, as the disease continues to spread rapidly through the north-east of the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), where the outbreak was announced in May.
This is the 17th outbreak of the highly infectious, often deadly disease in the DRC.

As of 2 October, 4,082 people had died out of 8,463 confirmed cases in the country  since the emergence  of the Bundibugyo strain of the Ebola virus, for which there is still no vaccine nor specific treatment.

stories.title: Flávio’s surprise first-round election win highlights rapid rise of Brazil’s House of Bolsonaro

As his far-right senator son heads into a runoff against the leftist incumbent, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, a  sweeping far-right victory  in congressional races also secured seats for Jair Bolsonaro’s wife, two of his sons and one of his brothers.
